$comment: Original ribbon color ramps. Geometry lives in scripts/lib/brand-mark.cjs.
face and smallFace run from light to dark; the return plane has a brighter middle bend.

amber.label: Amber / copper
amber.rationale: Warm amber and copper for the original rounded script ribbon.

garnet.label: Garnet / crimson
garnet.rationale: The colour of a marked-up script and of PowerPoint's warm end, but deeper and redder so it does not read as PowerPoint orange.

rose.label: Rose / magenta
rose.rationale: Vivid and unclaimed; the closest neighbour is OneNote's purple, which is a different family (violet, not pink).

violet.label: Violet / indigo
violet.rationale: OneNote owns purple in the Office family, and Figma owns multicolour, so this is the most contested candidate of the set.

teal.label: Teal / cyan
teal.rationale: Clean and technical; Teams sits nearby but at a greener, flatter hue, and cyan is otherwise unclaimed by document apps.

forest.label: Forest / green
forest.rationale: Excel owns green in the Office family; included for comparison so the reader can see the collision.

graphite.label: Graphite / slate
graphite.rationale: Neutral, and the safest choice if the icon must not compete with any other app on the taskbar; the cost is that a neutral sheet carries less of the Fluent 'saturated body' character.
